title: Partial candidate reruns select an artifact from the wrong attempt
symptom: Candidate run 39646320662 attempt 1 ended after macOS runner acquisition failed before any steps. Rerunning only the failed smoke job increments run_attempt while leaving the successful package job and its attempt-1 artifact intact. The original download name is computed from the consumer attempt and therefore selects an absent attempt-2 artifact. The actual hosted lookup result is still pending; the source wiring defect is reproduced locally.

rootCause.summary: The workflow incorrectly treats the consumer run_attempt as the producer artifact identity. Runner acquisition failure is an independent GitHub infrastructure condition, not a product or test failure.

requestedOutcome: A smoke-only rerun consumes exactly the original successful producer artifact and independent archive SHA without rebuilding. Missing identity must fail before download-all fallback. Preserve original failed/cancelled evidence.
decisions: Use upload artifact-id as a package output and needs input instead of reconstructing the name from run_attempt.
Require one positive safe-integer ID and one lowercase SHA-256 before invoking download-artifact; merge the one ID-selected artifact into the existing directory.
Keep all three hosted OSes and the existing archive verification. A future workflow patch cannot retroactively repair historical run source.

actions.description: Record infrastructure cancellation separately from the confirmed producer/consumer naming defect.
Implement immutable ID wiring and executable guard regressions; run focused tests, alignment and TypeScript checks.
Complete independent source and GLM review, then prove real smoke-only rerun without rebuilding.
Reconcile historical exact-archive hosted smoke and current documentation after measured outcomes.

verification.name: Old workflow regression reproduction
verification.scope: Original workflow before immutable ID repair; two new workflow regression tests.
verification.result: Both tests fail because upload ID output wiring and the pre-download guard are missing.

verification.name: Workflow and archive regression closure
verification.scope: Actual updated workflow guard, ID wiring, all three OS entries and existing archive safety tests; TypeScript and BoxBox layout checks.
verification.result: Six tests and 52 assertions pass. TypeScript and touched-file layout checks exit zero. This is local static/guard evidence, not hosted rerun acceptance.

verification.name: Hosted smoke-only rerun
verification.scope: New workflow source, unchanged successful package artifact ID and SHA across a consumer-only rerun.
verification.result: Requires a pushed reviewed workflow and actual GitHub execution; no output replay behavior is assumed.

related.note: Producer upload output and three-OS smoke consumer.
Executes the actual pre-download guard and checks workflow dependency wiring.
Read-only pinned action interface/source review and original artifact ID.

history.summary: Candidate and docs-head macOS jobs were cancelled without steps because hosted runners were not acquired. Failed-job-only reruns were requested after terminal cancellation.
Consumer attempt is not producer identity. Pinned download action also requires merge-multiple for ID selection and empty input falls back to all artifacts.
Two new regressions fail against the original workflow.
Added upload ID output, strict pre-download identity guard and one-ID flattened download; archive SHA and OS matrix retained.
Six focused tests, 52 assertions, TypeScript and touched-file layout checks pass; hosted verification remains separate.
